135210.overview:
He-Man and the Masters of the Universe is a side-scrolling brawler featuring He-Man, She-Ra and pals battling their way through Eternia to defeat the evil Hordak. Created in the OpenBOR engine, up to four players hack and slash through 28 levels of arcade fun based on the classic 80's cartoon.

Hordak has invaded Eternia, banished Skeletor and Evil-Lyn from Snake Mountain, and plans to steal the Diamonds of Power. To stop him, choose from a sizeable roster of playable characters, like Man-at-Arms, Orko, Sorceress, Teela, Skeletor, Evil-Lyn, Ram-Man, or even the Thundercats' Lion-O. Each character has their own special moves like flying or summoning the big cats, BattleCat and Panthor.

There's a Story mode and Versus mode, with a nice variety to the level design, mixing in platforming and shooter stages with ally protection, mazes and time-limited gameplay. Along the way, the heroes will encounter boss fights against some of the most memorable villains from the series, including fan favorites Beast Man, Mer-Man and Trap Jaw, among many others.

209006.overview:
Hyper Final Fight 3: Return of the Black is an OpenBOR beat 'em up created by Shin Azahara in 2015. Play as Haggar, Cody, Guy, Lucia, Mackie, Dean and Carlos, each of whom is equipped with a good set of special moves and combos.

Also known as Hyper Final Fight 3 - The Peace Keepers, this fan sequel by Shin Kazahara combines the whole cast from the orginal Final Fight series and puts you in control. Are you ready for another Metro City brawl?

216692.overview:
Head Hunters is the beat 'em up game inspired by the 8-bit classic Games such as Double Dragon 2 or Final Fight Fight. This game is playable for two players in cooperative mode, where player 1 gets the character of Hawk and player 2 Get the Character of Brad.

Head Hunters es un juego de beat 'em up inspirado en los juegos clásicos de NES de 8 bits como Double Dragon 2 o Mighty Final Fight. Este juego es jugable para dos jugadores en modo cooperativo, donde el jugador 1 obtiene el personaje de Hawk y el jugador 2 obtiene el personaje de Brad.

216805.overview:
Do you really need a story? Select one of three pilots and their signature space fighter model, fly forward and blow up as much stuff as you can. Grab power ups along the way, and make every ship in your fleet count - there's no continues here! Do you have what it takes for a Hyper Duel?

Hyper Duel was created and released by @BonusJZ. It is one of the first fully functional shooters powered by OpenBOR.

Hyper Duel is a Japanese video game developed by Technosoft and released in 1993. It is a horizontally scrolling shooter which takes inspiration from the Thunder Force series. The game has the player take control of a ship that can transform between a humanoid mecha and a space ship. The game was released in arcades in 1993, running on the TEC442-A hardware, then was ported to the Sega Saturn in 1996. It has never been released...

BonusJZ takes up the concept and transfers it to the OpenBOR engine but with a big difference, between this you cannot transform the ships into a humanoid wick and only the levels are a compilation of other Matamarcians...

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hyper Duel es un videojuego japonés desarrollado por Technosoft y lanzado en 1993 en Recreativas y luego fue portado a Sega Saturn en 1996. Es un juego de disparos de desplazamiento horizontal que se inspira en la serie Thunder Force, hace que el jugador tome el control de una nave que puede transformarse entre un mecha humanoide y una nave espacial.

BonusJZ retoma el concepto y lo traslada al motor OpenBOR pero con grandes diferencia, entre esto no se puede transformar las naves en mecha humanoide y solo los niveles son una compilación de otros matamarcianos...

425634.overview: Count Monte: "I made a game on Mugen called Escape From The Psycho, which pretended to be the victim in a horror movie. You're being chased by a maniac, and you had to escape to the safe zone at the end of the level. In his way there was "lots of obstacles, slowing you down and allowing the maniac to catch up to you. I'm turning this game into Openbor, and changing the generic maniac to Michael Myers, so it's a Halloween game."

453187.overview: Walk the Fury road as Ken or one of several others in this playable demo.
